name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoFlowM_cost
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (ids : List.{0} Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoFlowM g ids))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.rhoFlowCL g ids)

source.code:
theorem rhoFlowM_cost (ids : List ℕ) : (g.rhoFlowM ids).cost = g.rhoFlowCL ids := by
  simp only [rhoFlowM, rhoFlowCL, bind_cost, pure_cost, tick_cost, networkM_val,
    networkM_cost, Network.maxflowM_val, Network.maxflowM_cost]
  rw [filterM_val 1 _ (fun a => a.1 == g.netS) (fun a => rfl),
    filterM_cost 1 _ (fun a => g.netSC + (natC a.1 + natC g.netS)) (fun a => by simp)]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]

ids : List ℕ
⊢ g.networkCL ids +
      ((g.networkL ids).maxflowC natC +
        ((filterM 1
              (fun a => do
                let s ← g.netSM
                tick (natC a.1 + natC s)
                Pure.pure (a.1 == s))
              (g.networkL ids).maxflow).cost +
          ((filterM 1
                    (fun a => do
                      let s ← g.netSM
                      tick (natC a.1 + natC s)
                      Pure.pure (a.1 == s))
                    (g.networkL ids).maxflow).val.length +
              1 +
            0))) =
    g.networkCL ids + (g.networkL ids).maxflowC natC +
          (List.map (fun a => 1 + g.netSC + natC a.1 + natC g.netS) (g.networkL ids).maxflow).sum +
        (List.filter (fun a => a.1 == g.netS) (g.networkL ids).maxflow).length +
      1
